title: Accident in Springville at the intersection by the Walmart and Springville PD response.
summary: There was an accident about 1pm where a woman blew the stoplight hitting a young man in his car. She hit him at high speed and both cars went airborne. About half a dozen of us ran out to check on them and block the traffic from driving through the scene which they were trying to do.
